summary: Enhance your NGO's impact with our Introduction to MEL Training Course. Learn essential monitoring, evaluation, and learning strategies for effective programs.
lede: Monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) in NGO work connects project activities to outcomes and uses evidence to guide decisions. For NGO program and project staff, it involves building a results framework, selecting indicators, and planning data collection and quality checks. You’ll also practice analyzing findings, communicating results, and using feedback to improve programs.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across the NGO spectrum who are tasked with designing programs, tracking results, reporting to donors, and proving outcomes with evidence.
modules: Foundations of MEL in NGO Work
Logframes and Results Frameworks That Work
Data Collection Planning for Real Field Conditions
Tools for MEL Data Collection and Management
Intro to Evaluation and Learning-Focused Reviews
MEL for Adaptive Management and Decision-Making
Accountability to Communities and Feedback Mechanisms
Building a Simple MEL System for Your Organization
prerequisites: No prior MEL experience is required, but familiarity with NGO program management is beneficial.
